Chapter 1182: Chapter 5: The Ten Thousand Domains Come to Pay Homage (Subscription Requested)_2

"What’s going on? I thought our original homeland was quite good, why are we migrating again?"

Many human civilization evolvers hadn’t yet figured out the situation.

But soon received a detailed explanation—

"Our human civilization’s Galaxy Ultimate Being has already opened up a brand new Chaos Continent, and now we are to migrate there."

The Galaxy Ultimate Being?

Opening the Chaos Continent?

A small portion of human civilization evolvers took a deep breath. They were strong enough and had enough information to naturally understand what opening the Chaos Continent meant.

At least the strength of a Chaos Venerable is needed to achieve this feat.

"Has the Galaxy Ultimate Being crossed into the Chaos Realm?"

"Not crossed into the Chaos Realm, but perfected the Chaos Realm. Now the Galaxy Ultimate Being is also respectfully called the Galaxy Great Saint."

Within human civilization’s groups, many pieces of information about Lin Yuan began to spread.

This information was originally sealed by the three goddesses as it involved the pillar of human civilization, but now with Lin Yuan’s strength, there’s no need to seal it anymore.

...

"Junior Brother has become a Chaos Great Saint?"

Among the many humans migrating to the Chaos Continent, Chikun Star Lord and many disciple Peak Masters gathered in one place, discussing this matter incredulously.

"How long has it even been?"

Chikun Star Lord was also shocked in his heart. He had long known that Lin Yuan would inevitably lead human civilization to its peak, but he didn’t expect this day to come so quickly and unexpectedly.

Chaos Great Saint?

Chikun Star Lord, being Lin Yuan’s teacher, had an understanding of the various levels of strong beings in the Chaos Void.

A Chaos Great Saint is a perfect existence of the twelfth layer. The reason the native universe prematurely collapsed into great destruction was due to the influence of a battle between two Chaos Great Saints.

...

"Chaos Great Saint..."

Wanyang Holy Son, following the many evolvers of the Wanyang Lineage, also started migrating to the Chaos Continent.

"Galaxy Great Saint..." Wanyang Holy Son was dumbfounded. He had only just learned some information about the Chaos Great Saint, and before today, he had no idea what a Chaos Great Saint meant.

Even with a brief understanding, Wanyang Holy Son realized how great an existence a Chaos Great Saint is. And now, the Galaxy Master who once competed with him on the arena stage has reached this level?

"Back in the arena match, it seems I even won against the Galaxy Great Saint once." Wanyang Holy Son swallowed, thinking about his glorious achievement.

At the time, he didn’t think much of it, but now it appears that arena battle made him forever memorable in human civilization history.

After all, that was the Galaxy Great Saint, whose defeats have been exceedingly rare since he came into being.

...

"I didn’t expect the legacy I left behind would have such a significant impact."

Ou Yin was migrating to the Chaos Continent, feeling a myriad of emotions at the moment.

Before he died, he hid his legacy in a corner of the Battlefields of Different Races, originally intending to leave it to the descendants of human civilization evolvers, but it ended up in the hands of the Galaxy Great Saint.

Galaxy Great Saint... Due to this connection with the Galaxy Great Saint, Ou Yin received many privileges within the human civilization group. When scholars of human civilization history studied the past deeds of the Galaxy Ultimate Being, they gave high praise to the legacy he left behind.

For tenth or eleventh layer evolvers, those legacies weren’t worth mentioning, but at the time, the Galaxy Great Saint’s strength was still weak; it was considered his first pot of gold.

...

"Opening a Chaos Continent... Galaxy Great Saint..."

Dozens of alien Path Splitting Realm beings looked at each other in dismay. Originally, they had submitted to the Galaxy Ultimate Being under the threat of the universe’s great destruction, only to unexpectedly find that they had submitted to a Great Saint, the Galaxy Great Saint.

"Although our status is not as high as human civilization evolvers, we can still migrate to that Chaos Continent, which is better than many powerful groups."

A Star Alliance Path Splitting Realm expert spoke.

This remark also gained the approval of other alien Path Splitting Realm beings.

If you beat the dog, you have to look at the owner, let alone the Galaxy Great Saint now.

"We should be fortunate to have been born in the same universe as the Galaxy Great Saint; otherwise, we would have perished long ago."

An alien Path Splitting Realm being said with emotion. It was said that when one person achieved the Dao, even the dogs and chickens ascended to heaven. The Galaxy Great Saint, with personal power, brought boundless benefits to the entire native universe.

As long as they did not eventually oppose the Galaxy Great Saint, even if they were now slaves of the Galaxy Great Saint, the resources they enjoyed far exceeded those of the same level powerhouses.

...

Many humans rapidly migrated, although they had left the native universe for those years.

The entire human civilization was striving for reproduction, and the population size increased tens to hundreds of times compared to the beginning.

But compared to the vast Chaos Continent opened by Lin Yuan, it was still far from enough, like a drop of water falling into the ocean, completely inconspicuous.

"Those... are they all Venerables?"

Xuanyuan Supreme looked beyond the Chaos Continent, where terrifying auras were entering one by one.

Each aura imposed immense pressure on Xuanyuan Supreme, but before entering the Chaos Continent, these existences were exceedingly careful.

"In my entire life, I have never seen so many Chaos Venerables."

Void God Ultimate Being said that the gathering of such a number of Venerables was indeed rare.

"It’s all because of the Galaxy..."

Xia Qin Ultimate Being couldn’t help but say.

"Indeed, without the Galaxy, these Venerables?"

The other few Ultimate Beings nodded. Chaos Venerables were high above, and a Void Domain had only about seven to eight of them.

If it weren’t for the Galaxy Great Saint, which Venerable would have put in such effort to come here?

...

In the void.

Several figures appeared, looking distantly at the newly opened Chaos Continent.

"Black Light, you’re here."

Wild Barbarian Great Saint glanced at one who had just arrived and said.

"If I didn’t come, what would happen to the main battle body?" Black Light Great Saint slightly shook his head.

Lin Yuan offered them ten billion chaos stones in exchange for the main battle body. Although the cost was high, it was still more economical than cultivating a new main battle body.

More importantly, cultivating a new main battle body requires not only a large investment in resources but also time.

"To gather ten billion chaos stones, I owed quite a few favors."

Wild Barbarian Great Saint was a bit helpless.

"So did I."

Black Light Great Saint said.

The property of a Great Saint is mostly invested in weapons and arms.

As for chaos stones? They are not abundant, so if one wants to gather enough chaos stones quickly, either they sell their personal weapons or borrow.

And borrowing chaos stones from other Great Saints requires repaying favors.

"This is the Chaos Continent opened by Galaxy Great Saint?"

Black Light Great Saint began to observe the distant Chaos Continent, his expression growing increasingly amazed.

With his keen insight, even if he had just arrived and hadn’t seen the process of the Chaos Continent opening, he sensed a suppression in space-time aspects.

"The Galaxy Great Saint’s comprehension in space-time must have reached the Ninth Realm." Wild Barbarian Great Saint said beside him.

He’d been here for quite some time, waiting for the other Great Saints to gather and meet the Galaxy Great Saint together, and observing the distant Chaos Continent.

The more he observed, the more the shock grew in Wild Barbarian Great Saint’s heart.

"The Ninth Realm comprehension of space-time?"

Black Light Great Saint took a deep breath, knowing well the difficulty of raising space-time comprehension to the Ninth Realm; only an absolute Great Saint could achieve it by following the path of chaos evolution. It’s almost impossible for ordinary Chaos Great Saints.

"Back then, did Lin Yuan reach the Ninth Realm of space-time comprehension?"

Black Light Great Saint said, that if Lin Yuan had reached the Ninth Realm of space-time comprehension back then, suppressing them a few Chaos Great Saints wouldn’t have taken long.

It would’ve been even more impossible for Dual Origin Great Saint to escape.

Dual Origin Great Saint’s shattering power of space-time was indeed strong, but facing the Ninth Realm’s suppression of space-time, unless he resisted Galaxy Great Saint head-on, he would have long perished.

"Hiding his strength?"

Wild Barbarian Great Saint speculated, which is the only explanation.

"Hiding his strength?"

Black Light Great Saint remained silent.

Beside them, Tian Lu Great Saint and other Chaos Great Saints trembled at heart. To be able to sweep through other Chaos Great Saints, yet still hide strength?
